programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Based on the international bestselling book of the same name, by Dr. Michael Greger, this movie plays like a fast-paced action thriller but is packed with hard-hitting data that just might save your life. How Not to Die exposes the role of the standard Western diet in fueling today’s most widespread illnesses. The film offers jaw-dropping, but evidence-based, insights into the prevention of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver dysfunction, and a spectrum of brain disorders, including dementia and Alzheimer’s disease. It also addresses how diet influences the development of colon, prostate, and other digestive cancers, delivering life-saving information with clarity and authority.

programme.desc: Forks Over Knives explores the groundbreaking claim that chronic diseases like heart disease and type 2 diabetes can be prevented—or even reversed—through a whole-food, plant-based diet. Follow the journeys of Dr. T. Colin Campbell and Dr. Caldwell Esselstyn, whose research reveals the power of food as medicine. See how real people transform their lives and health by rejecting animal-based and processed foods.

programme.title: Lord Rama Rangoli
programme.desc: Rangoli is a traditional Indian art form where decorative patterns are created on floors using colored powders, rice flour, or sand, especially during festivals.Create a Lord Rama rangoli inspired by Dussehra festival traditions.

programme.title: Shifting Gears
programme.desc: Shifting Gears is the all-new authoritative guide to the latest trends and technology from within today’s ever-changing automotive industry. From the racetrack to the suburban street, Shifting Gears delivers the most up-to-date news on cutting edge research, development and design. We delve beneath the skin of some of the most advanced machines on the planet – we visit international motor shows for the newest releases and concept vehicles; uncover new advances in technology developed both in the laboratory and on the race track; keep up to date in the race for alternative fuels, improved safety, satellite navigation, in-car entertainment and multi-media connectivity; and look ahead to the designs and trends of the future. From luxury dream machines and fantasy prototypes to the globally marketed mainstays, our access to the world’s leading race teams and automotive manufacturers ensure we have every corner covered. Enjoy the ride, as the future unfolds and we keep on shifting gears!

Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.desc: Samson is blessed with magical hair that gives him inhuman strength and hypnotically attracts women and men. programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Johanna Dohnal - Visionary of Feminism
programme.desc: Dohnal worked in the SPÖ from 1956 and was a minister from 1979 to 1995. Under her leadership, rape within marriage became punishable, guardianship of unmarried mothers was abolished, sexual harassment became a criminal offense, and expulsion in cases of domestic violence became law. Women's shelters, gender quotas, and equal treatment laws were established for the first time.

programme.title: Bella Solitaria
programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. Cada día, ella recibe de forma anónima una caja de leche con un Post-it pegado, el que sigue una historia uno tras otro. Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

programme.title: Kursi, Parc National, Israel
programme.desc: Le parc national de Kursi en Israel est un site archeologique et historique situe sur la rive est de la mer de Galilee. Il conserve les vestiges d’un monastere et d’une eglise byzantins, traditionnellement consideres comme le lieu du miracle des porcs de Geraseens par Jesus, et offre aux visiteurs des vues panoramiques, des mosaïques anciennes et un aperçu de l’histoire chretienne ancienne.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Honduras
programme.desc: Los Exploradores, dirigidos por Olivier Chiabodo, desplegaron sus equipos para elaborar un inventario pictórico de las maravillas naturales de una tierra descubierta por el explorador inglés James Cook en 1774: Nueva Caledonia. Pero también para descubrir la cultura de los primeros habitantes de la isla, los melanesios.

programme.title: Deliciosisimo

programme.title: Tiempo Para Nuestro Cuerpo y Mente
programme.desc: Una serie dedicada al bienestar fisico y mental a traves de ejercicios, yoga, pilates y diferentes practicas saludables. Especialistas y entrenadores comparten clases, tecnicas y experiencias que inspiran a cuidar el cuerpo, encontrar equilibrio y vivir de forma mas consciente.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Hippos, Israel
programme.desc: Hippos (Sussita) est une ancienne ville greco-romaine situee sur une colline surplombant la mer de Galilee dans le nord d’Israel. Fondee a l’epoque hellenistique, elle a prospere en tant que partie de la Decapole et est aujourd’hui connue pour ses impressionnantes ruines, ses rues, ses temples, sa basilique et ses portes de ville, temoignant d’un riche melange de culture classique et d’histoire chretienne ancienne.

programme.title: Beyhadh
programme.desc: Maya es una joven magnate de los negocios que ha triunfado en el mundo corporativo. Ella se enamora perdidamente de Arjun, un apuesto galán que ama la fotografía. En la misma empresa trabaja Saanjh, una bella joven enamoradiza.

programme.title: Site de bapteme de Yardenit, Israel
programme.desc: Le site de baptême de Yardenit est un lieu paisible et sacre situe sur le fleuve Jourdain dans le nord d’Israel. Reconnu comme un site traditionnel associe au baptême de Jesus, il accueille des pelerins du monde entier pour la reflexion spirituelle, la priere et les ceremonies de baptême dans un cadre naturel serein.

programme.desc: Vi møter vi Ivar og Asgeir. De har kjøpt en Volvo 142, som de skal bygge om til en rask rallybil for å delta i Rallye Monte-Carlo Historique. I Drammen treffer vi Arild Olsen som har kjøpt en Ferrari han ikke har sett på nett.

programme.title: Garasjen - Mekking av både Ferrari og Volvo 142, og et lite lakk kurs
programme.desc: Halvor Sunde fra Risør åpner dørene til sin egen garasje, som blant annet huser en strøken Hotrod. Asgeir besøker Arild og hans Ferrari, og gir ham en hjelpende hånd når motoren skal settes inn. Videre går turen til Gatebil on ice i Sigdal.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1980-1990
programme.desc: 80-tallet er preget av racinglegender. En ny verdensmester kommer på banen, og viser frem motorer med 1.200 hester. Porche 959 er den raskeste landeveisbilen i verden. Motorsport har mer å si enn noen gang, og tiårene er fyllt med store motorer.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1947-1960
programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1960-1970
programme.desc: 1960-tallet er fargerikt og bilmarkedet vokser. Småbiler er blitt veldig populære, og middelklassen er på utkikk etter bil. Hvis du har råd, vil drømmen din gå i oppfyllelse.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - -20 Grad & Allrad: Was soll schon schief gehen? Im Porsche Taycan 4 auf Eis
programme.desc: Porsche bietet den Basis-Taycan jetzt auch mit Allrad an. Gleiche Leistung, aber gut 5.000 Euro teurer. Lohnt sich das Upgrade auf den Taycan 4? Alexander Bloch testet den neuen Taycan 4 auf Eis und Schnee. Wie macht sich der Allrad und vor allem: Wie lädt der Elektro-Sportwagen bei -20 Grad?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 8 Fakten zu Lackschutzfolien
programme.desc: Steinschläge, Lackkratzer und die Launen der Natur können das Aussehen und den Wert eines Autos erheblich beeinträchtigen. Doch es gibt eine Lösung, die nicht nur schützt, sondern auch stylisch ist: die Autofolierung. Alex erklärt welche Unterschiede es gibt und was es bei einer Folierung zu beachten gibt. Mit Drahtbürste, Steinschleuder und Gabelstapler macht Alex außerdem den Extrem-Haltbarkeitstest einer Lackschutzfolie.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Citroën ë-C3: Nur günstig? Oder auch gut?
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch checkt den neuen Citroën ë-C3. Mit einem Basispreis von 23.300 Euro zählt er zu den günstigsten E-Autos am Markt. Aber ist er nur billig oder auch wirklich sein Geld wert? Alexander Bloch macht den Test und zeigt auch die Unterschiede zum C3-Verbrenner und zum Konkurrenten Dacia Spring.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Cupra Tavascan VZ: Wieder der gleiche MEB-Brei?
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch testet den neuen Cupra Tavascan VZ - erneut ein E-Auto auf dem MEB. Auf diesem Baukasten stehen bereits VW ID.4, Skoda Enyaq & Co. - Was ist gleich, was ist anders und was überrascht?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Renault Scenic E-Tech
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1996 betrat der erste Renault Mégane Scénic den Markt und gliederte sich im Segment der kompakten Vans ein. Aus Megane und Scenic entwickelten sich zwei eigenständige Baureihen. Welche Qualitäten der neue Scenic E-Tech im Vergleich zu seinem kleinen Bruder hat, findet Alex Bloch heraus.

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: 20.0 Megaquake
programme.desc: Mentre un mega-terremoto minaccia San Francisco, una serie di scosse di preavviso crea scompiglio in tutta la città. Una squadra d'élite di esperti di servizi di emergenza e di catastrofi converge sull'epicentro previsto, lavorando instancabilmente per salvare quante più vite possibili prima che la città venga schiacciata nell'oblio.

programme.title: Ice Storm - Tempesta Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Disaster movie targato Asylum. Quando una violenta tempesta invernale colpisce la Carolina del Nord, trascinando le temperature al minimo storico, l'intero Stato rischia di precipitare in una glaciale catastrofe. Mentre il gelo avanza, scienziati ed esperti lottano contro il tempo per salvare vite umane e fermare il disastro prima che tutta la costa orientale venga inghiottita dal ghiaccio.

programme.title: Un Natale Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Action movie ambientato tra i ghiacci dell’Alaska con Brendan Fehr e Jodelle Ferland. Siamo alla Vigilia di Natale e l’idillio delle feste viene bruscamente interrotto quando i ghiacciai, sciogliendosi, iniziano a rilasciare grandi quantità di metano liquido che, se non fermato, rischia di far esplodere l'intero pianeta.

programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Retrograde
programme.desc: Un virus, trasportato da alcuni meteoriti, giace in stato latente in Antartide da migliaia di anni. Agli inizi del 2000, involontariamente risvegliato da una squadra di geologi, l'organismo alieno scatena la più mortale epidemia della storia.

programme.title: End Of The World
programme.desc: Mentre una massa di tempeste solari provoca tsunami, vulcani e inondazioni, una famiglia tenta di fuggire dalla città verso la relativa salvezza in un gruppo di grotte ad alta quota a diverse miglia di distanza dall'occhio del ciclone.

programme.title: Geo Disaster
programme.desc: Una famiglia di Los Angeles si trova separata durante la convergenza dei più grandi disastri della storia, un super vulcano, un mega-terremoto e un enorme tornado, e cercheranno di riunirsi a tutti i costi.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: Quando una meteora si schianta sulla luna e ne sposta l'asse, la gravità terrestre trascina la luna sulla traiettoria del pianeta. Ora un gruppo di scienziati deve capire come impedire alla luna di colpire la Terra prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: San Andreas Quake
programme.desc: Dopo aver avuto la carriera screditata a causa di un incidente, una sismologa mette in guardia la popolazione circa un terremoto di proporzioni immani che colpirà Los Angeles, ma nessuno le crede.

programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Islande, sur la Piste du Renard Polaire
programme.desc: C'est une île posée sur un océan glacial, créée par les volcans, sculptée par les glaciers et les cascades. Au nord de cette île, on se lance dans une quête : rencontrer et filmer le seul mammifère originaire d'Islande.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Costa Rica, le Royaume des Colibris
programme.desc: Le Costa Rica est une étroite bande de terre avec de chaque côté un océan. Au centre, d'épaisses forêts et de ténébreux volcans, partout, on y rencontre d'étonnants animaux, qui semblent avoir accepté un peu mieux notre espèce. Des oiseaux multicolores, des reptiles un peu moins discret, mammifères plutôt curieux, partout se livre un fabuleux spectacle de la nature.

programme.title: RAZOR：Artificial Vision
programme.desc: Around 40 million people worldwide are blind and a further 250 million are visually impaired. It's a disability that poses extraordinary challenges. At Miguel Hernandez University in Southern Spain, scientists have created a visual neuroprosthesis that's designed to restore a limited but useful sense of vision in profoundly blind patients. In essence, they are creating artificial vision. RAZOR's Gabrielle Lawrence meets the lead scientist Professor Eduardo Fernandez and hears from some of the patients involved in the study. These cutting-edge implants are designed to stimulate the retina or visual cortex, allowing users to perceive shapes, light, and potentially even detailed images. This pioneering work represents a major step forward in the field of neuroprosthetics and offers renewed hope for millions living with vision loss.

programme.title: RAZOR: Huawei Norway Salmon
programme.desc: Norway's fjords and rivers are home to the iconic wild Atlantic salmon, but its population has fallen by half since the 1980s and now faces a growing threat from invasive Pacific pink salmon. Along the Tana River, locals have built traditional fish traps to intercept and manually sort the intruders, while new technology offers fresh hope in smaller rivers. Under its TECH4ALL initiative, Huawei, together with partners like the Berlevag Hunting and Fishing Association, has developed an AI-powered filtering system using underwater cameras, 5G, and solar power to identify fish with over 99% accuracy, diverting invasive salmon into holding tanks while letting native species pass freely. In 2023 alone, the system removed more than 6,000 pink salmon, cut manual labor by 90%, and avoided harm to native fish — a model now set to scale across Norway and potentially worldwide.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Xinjiang's role in Eurasia connectivity
programme.desc: From the bustling lanes of the world's largest bazaar in Urumqi to the humming logistics hubs at the region's 19 ports, Xinjiang is transforming its geographical advantage into economic strength. As China's gateway to the west, it now hosts a major network for opening-up, including the pioneering Pilot Free Trade Zone. This episode explores how cross-border trade, a web of China-Europe freight trains, and cultural exchanges are weaving Xinjiang into the very heart of the Belt and Road Initiative, making it a pivotal hub for continental connectivity.

programme.title: From Economic Corridors to Space Cooperation: Where are China-Pakistan Ties Heading?
programme.desc: On the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif completed a visit to China. The two countries deepened strategic mutual trust, advanced the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor 2.0, and signed cooperation agreements to boost trade, agriculture, education, and media cooperation. What opportunities will the upgraded CPEC unlock? How do cultural and people-to-people exchanges connect young people from both sides? Why does cooperation in space embody profound mutual trust? Host Xu Yawen is joined by Mahnoor Makhdoom, a Journalist at Daily Mail Pakistan; Muhammad Zamir Assadi, the Director of the China Desk at Lord Media Network; and Ali.TM, Chief Editor and Podcast Host with Othernews.pk for in-depth discussions.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: Miao culture extravaganza
programme.desc: What do spicy peppers, handmade guitars, and green cities have in common? Guizhou. In our new on-the-ground mini-series ChinaHorizons, we invite you to join our trip to Guizhou province. For the first stop, we record our podcast in a traditional Miao people's village cluster to appreciate diversified cultures, intangible cultural heritage items and delicious local cuisines.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird’s eye can see into the west….

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan

Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures...

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: El penalti más largo del mundo
programme.desc: Un portero sin esperanza debe detener el penalti más esperado del mundo.

programme.title: El pozo
programme.desc: Pilar no se comunica con los otros, vive en su propio mundo de fantasías, hasta que la familia toma una decision que cambiara el rumbo de sus vidas.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: El secuestro es algo muy común entre rivales, pero cuando se escoge a la persona equivocada se convierte en un error que trae consecuencias drásticas.

programme.title: Una mirada al mar
programme.desc: Rufino becomes a widower and returns to the town where he met his wife. There he reunites with his great friend Gaspar, who takes care of an orphan girl named Ana-E, with whom he will have a hostile coexistence. Loneliness will both confront and unite them.

programme.title: 6 Impactos
programme.desc: Un traficante roba a su patrón para salvar a su hijo.

programme.title: Capa Caída
programme.desc: Un documental sigue a Magno, superhéroe caído tras un escándalo, 20 años después.

programme.title: El Verano que te vimos
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos se reencuentra para festejar año nuevo.

programme.title: Cápsulas
programme.desc: Fonsi vive una vida peligrosa con su madre y el novio narcotraficante. Fonsi es secuestrado por su padre, dándole la oportunidad de iniciar una nueva relación y ver la vida desde una perspectiva diferente.

programme.title: Los Borgia
programme.desc: Un retrato de la sangrienta dinastía que dio lugar a un papa, Alejandro VI, así como al modelo de referencia para "El Príncipe" de Maquiavelo.

programme.title: 6 Impactos
programme.desc: Un traficante roba a su patrón para salvar a su hijo.

programme.title: Capa Caída
programme.desc: Un documental sigue a Magno, superhéroe caído tras un escándalo, 20 años después.

programme.title: Megalodon Rising
programme.desc: Cuando el mayor depredador acuático de la historia regresa, la armada de modernos buques de guerra enviada para destruirlo no tiene ninguna posibilidad.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: Un operativo de Black Ops es enviado a una remota estación de la CIA para proteger a un operador de código. Pronto se encuentran en una situación a vida o muerte, intentando desmantelar una trama letal antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Después de devorar a la población de peces, miles de lampreas hambrientas comienzan a atacar a los ciudadanos de una tranquila ciudad lacustre, y la comunidad lucha por mantenerse con vida.

programme.title: Vacaciones Tragicas
programme.desc: Una familia se ve atrapada cuando la casa de vacaciones que alquilan se inunda por la lluvia y un agresivo tiburón ha conseguido entrar.

programme.title: Arachnid
programme.desc: Una expedición científica que investiga el brote de una epidemia vírica desconocida en una isla del sur del Pacífico se enfrenta a una araña alienígena gigante en la jungla.

programme.title: El Cobrador 2
programme.desc: Two debt collectors are plunged into an extremely dangerous situation, pursuing various criminals while evading a vengeful enemy.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo de operaciones encubiertas es enviado a investigar el accidente de un avión no identificado, pronto se encuentran perseguidos por sus antiguos ocupantes.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio de Los Ángeles, entonces uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error.. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Planet Dune V2
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Catástrofe Inminente
programme.desc: Una gran oleada de asteroides atraviesa el Sistema Solar provocando que la Tierra salga de su órbita y sufriendo una gran devastación. La única oportunidad para los supervivientes es que la fuerza del Sol recupere el control sobre la Tierra pero, aunque lo haga, la vida en el planeta habrá cambiado para siempre. Si alguien te dijera que el mundo se acabará mañana, ¿le creerías?

programme.title: Tren de Bala Abatido
programme.desc: En su viaje inaugural, el tren de alta velocidad más rápido del mundo está equipado con una bomba que explotará si desciende por debajo de las 200 mph.

programme.title: La Fuga
programme.desc: Tras hacerse con el control de una prisión de máxima seguridad, un cerebro criminal se enfrenta a un agente retirado de Black Ops que había estado visitando a su hijo encarcelado.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: L'histoire est centrée sur une bataille qui s'est déroulée pendant la période des États combattants en Chine, une série de guerres civiles qui s'est étendue du 5e au 3e siècle avant J.-C. Basée sur un manga japonais populaire, elle était elle-même basée sur un roman japonais inspiré de l'histoire des États combattants en Chine

programme.title: La Colonie
programme.desc: Des groupes de personnes – des colonies – sont forcés de vivre sous terre à cause d'une nouvelle ère glaciaire. La Colonie 7 part vérifier la situation de la Colonie 5, avec laquelle ils ont perdu le contact. Sur place, ils découvrent que la colonie est tombée et qu’un tout nouvel ennemi les attend sur le chemin du retour.

programme.title: Karyn l'Obstinée
programme.desc: Une inspectrice de la criminelle est obligée de travailler avec son ex-fiancé pour enquêter sur un meurtre qui porte toutes les marques d'un infâme tueur en série.

programme.title: L'Ange Gardien
programme.desc: Après avoir enquêté sur une série de crimes violents, deux inspecteurs de la police de Los Angeles découvrent une nouvelle drogue liée à un pouvoir surnaturel terrifiant.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: Six ans après l'invasion de la Terre par les extraterrestres, un journaliste désabusé accepte d'escorter une touriste américaine choquée depuis une zone infectée au Mexique jusqu'à la sécurité de la frontière américaine.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l’économie s’effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu’il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu’à l’extrême pour se venger de la vie qu’on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Au cour de la « White Christmas » parti du complexe ultra-luxueux « Sky Tower », un feu se déclare. Le feu a commencé lorsque les hélicoptères supposés saupoudrer de la neige au-dessus du bâtiment sont entrés en contact avec le bâtiment. Les pompiers sont rapidement envoyés afin de sauver l’ensemble des locataires et les invités VIP du building.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: Un patron du crime envoie son meilleur homme pour tuer un prisonnier. Il se trompe d'homme et en paie le prix. 6 mois plus tard, il est de nouveau sur pied. Son ex-patron se fait maintenant évincer par Ice Man, qui est responsable de l'affaire de la "mauvaise personne".

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d’adolescents en vacances au bord d’une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes. Pour rester en vie, ils vont devoir se confronter aux castors zombies qui les attaquent dans leurs propres cabines...

programme.title: Rescue Team
programme.desc: Sur une ile Asiatique, une équipe de scientifiques étudie la récente apparition d’un virus mortel. Ce dernier prend la forme d’une maladie dégénérescente et les habitants locaux en sont les premières victimes. Après avoir découvert l’existence d’un « elixir de vie », les scientifiques vont disparaitre en laissant derrière eux un message d’alerte concernant cette terrible maladie qui se propage rapidement. Les forces armées internationales et des mercenaires prêts à tout, débarquent sur l’ile avec un enjeu majeur, la survie de l’humanité pour certains mais surtout de nombreux intérêts personnels.

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: I Dieci Gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Eminence Hills
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza conduce a un notorio asesino y a un agente de la ley a un pueblo de fanáticos. Correrá la sangre.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Un veterano confederado que vive en el Norte yanqui lucha contra el mutismo inducido por el shock de su hijo y el odio de los norteños.

programme.title: I Pirati Della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d’Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también. Django (o Sartana, según la versión de la película) lo encuentra y lee la carta que Jimmy había recibido de su hermana Jessica Dublin contándole el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce
programme.desc: Con Yvonne De Carlo, passioni e destino si intrecciano nella Roma attraversata da grandi cambiamenti.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Matar Caballería
programme.desc: El general estadounidense Hudson Kilpatrick es conocido por muchos como la "Matar Caballería", no por el número de tropas enemigas que ha matado, sino por las suyas propias, debido a decisiones atroces que provocaron numerosas bajas.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: Cruce de Bastardos
programme.desc: Sigue la historia de Cam Talcutt, un hombre que ganó un puesto comercial en un juego de cartas.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Tierra de alfareros
programme.desc: Un ex confederado intenta empezar de cero en una granja de Texas con su mujer y su hija pequeña. Rápidamente aprende que a veces el pasado no permanece enterrado.

programme.title: Nel Segno Di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell’antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.

programme.title: Il Gladiatore Di Roma
programme.desc: Nell’arena e nei palazzi del potere, un gladiatore combatte tra intrighi e duelli per cambiare il proprio destino.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: Messalina
programme.desc: Con Belinda Lee, Messalina intreccia seduzione e potere nella Roma imperiale tra passioni e congiure.

programme.title: Buen Funeral Amigos paga Sartana
programme.desc: Cuando una joven hereda una mina de oro de su tío asesinado, Sartana acude en su ayuda mientras varios estafadores, incluido el sheriff local, intentan reclamarla como suya.

programme.title: Piena Di Grazia
programme.desc: Dopo la resurrezione, Maria guida i discepoli tra dubbi e speranza custodendo il messaggio destinato a cambiare il mondo.

programme.title: SIN NOMBRE Y DINAMITA
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite comienza cuando conocemos a la pareja de cazarrecompensas formada por No Name (Northup) y Dynamite Davenport (Ting), que siguen su propio camino para cobrar las recompensas, pero se ayudan mutuamente cuando se trata de las recompensas más difíciles.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Un hombre inculpado de asesinato escapa de la cárcel y se dirige al Oeste, donde se une a una banda en la que está implicado el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: I Dieci Gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: En Tombstone, un nuevo sheriff jura limpiar la ciudad de forajidos como los hermanos O'Hara y cuenta con la ayuda de un extraño abogado que siempre lleva consigo dos grandes libros de derecho.

programme.title: Ercole Contro Roma
programme.desc: Tra rivolte, tradimenti e scontri spettacolari, Ercole affronta Roma per difendere il suo popolo e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: El Valor de un Corbade
programme.desc: La banda de los Blackie lleva a cabo el atraco perfecto a un banco. Pero, ¿quién se llevó el dinero?

programme.title: Davide E Golia
programme.desc: Con Orson Welles, Davide affronta Golia nella sfida che segna il destino di Israele

programme.title: El calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: Un sheriff intenta detener los conflictos entre colonos en el Oeste tras la Guerra de Secesión.

programme.title: Il Terrore Dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un’avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: 7 Winchester per un Massacro
programme.desc: Un pistolero se une a una banda de guerrilleros confederados para encontrar un alijo de oro confederado desaparecido.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Quand il était petit, Johnny a vu son père tué par des soldats. Des années plus tard, il est devenu un hors-la-loi et tue des soldats chaque fois qu'il le peut. Le lieutenant Garringo (Steffen) est envoyé pour arrêter Johnny (Lawrence) et le ramener vivant.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Trois déserteurs se sont échappés d'une caserne de l'armée pour rejoindre le Ponderosa. Lorsqu'un capitaine vient les chercher, Ben comprend ce qu'ils ont dû endurer et promet de faire connaître la vérité à son bon ami responsable du fort.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Un homme, un cheval et un pistolet
programme.desc: Un pistolero cynique, aidé par un vieux prophète, se retrouve mêlé à une querelle avec une bande de bandits qui tentent de s'emparer d'une diligence en or massif.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Trinita va tout casser
programme.desc: Les victimes de Honey, le chef oppressif de la ville, reçoivent l'aide d'une alliance inhabituelle entre des hommes armés et des artistes de cirque.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne
programme.desc: Un tireur solitaire traque les membres d'un gang de hors-la-loi qui a tué ses amis.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: Le shérif adjoint Bass Reeves retrouve son ancien partenaire et fugitif Sam Tanner. Avec un ancien tireur d'élite de l'Union, ils font face à une course contre la montre pour retrouver Jack Donner et sa bande impitoyable de tueurs.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.desc: VOZ NEWS es el noticiero estelar de VOZ, con las principales noticias del país y del mundo, seguidas por un análisis en profundidad de temas destacados de la jornada. El ciclo es presentado por la reconocida periodista televisiva Karina Yapor, acompañada de un equipo de destacados periodistas y de analistas políticos, económicos y sociales.

programme.title: Sid Roth - ¡Es Sobrenatural!
programme.desc: Sid Roth, un judío creyente en Jesús, ha pasado más de 35 años investigando la cualidad sobrenatural de Dios. Él quiere guiarte para que tengas una relación íntima con Dios y camines en milagros.

programme.title: Joni Table Talk
programme.desc: Con ideas de su libro "Forgiveness for Everyone" (Perdón para Todos), el Dr. Doug Weiss revela cómo el perdón puede desbloquear la sanidad y el crecimiento en cada área de tu vida.

programme.title: Ministry Now
programme.desc: Al frente de la nueva normalidad de hoy, la familia Lamb lleva a los espectadores de todo el mundo a Ministry Now. Lleno de fe radical, declaraciones alentadoras y consejos positivos, este programa le ayudará a cambiar su perspectiva hacia la esperanza que Dios aún tiene para su futuro.

programme.title: Aqua viva con Sergio Hornung
programme.desc: Aqua Viva presenta al Pastor Sergio Hornung cada semana compartiendo un mensaje cargado de fe, vision y herramientas practicas, a fin de experimentar una genuina transformación por el poder del Espíritu Santo.

programme.title: Impactando las Naciones
programme.desc: Impactando Naciones es un programa televisivo conducido por la Pastora Wanda Rolón, dedicado a compartir un mensaje transformador de fe, esperanza y poder espiritual y motivando a todo aquel que busca una experiencia real con Dios.

programme.title: Sin Miedo a Nada
programme.desc: El Pastor Iván Delgado te invita a vivir sin fronteras, a derribar obstáculos internos y externos, y a experimentar el poder de la Palabra como fuerza que transforma, sana y dirige el futuro.

programme.title: Fe y Fuego
programme.desc: Dios nos da herramientas para sobrevivir el desierto, el desierto no va a pasar, nosotros somos los que pasamos por el desierto. Dios le dijo al pueblo de Israel que cruce el mar rojo. El desierto no es el destino final, es solo parte del viaje.

programme.title: Find Me Beyond the Kitchen Ep.3
programme.desc: This film follows four culinary artists: a Yunnan-based chef specializing in plant-based cuisine; a Tibetan baker; a Chinese-Western fusion pastry chef; and an artist/restaurant owner. These are true masters of the kitchen, honoring their time-honored cuisines while staying true to their original visions.

programme.title: Our Wild Neighbors Ep.1
programme.desc: This film turns its lens to the wild animals living in our cities. It's a story about conservation that also asks a deeper question: what kind of city do we want to build, and what kind of planning and design will create a better life for people while leaving room for everyone else? Perhaps by reimagining urban development, there is a way for humans and nature to truly coexist.

programme.desc: This documentary provides an immersive look into the intangible cultural heritage techniques woven into Chinese dance drama. programme.title: Our Neighbors in the Wild Ep.2
programme.desc: Urban wildlife thrives by embedding itself into city life, serving as an indicator of ecosystem health. This documentary highlights these “neighbors” to inspire better city planning for harmony between man and nature.

programme.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Dolphins and Whales: Tribes of the Ocean
programme.desc: Dive into a new immersive and highly emotional adventure with Jean-Michel Cousteau's Dolphins and Whales 3D.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: Turtle Odyssey
programme.desc: Sea turtles are some of Earth's most ancient and majestic creatures. For over 100 million years, they have traversed the seas, enduring mass extinctions and playing critical roles in maintaining food webs. But now they face a new threat – humans. It's time we learned more about these remarkable reptiles.

programme.title: Strange Creatures of the Batangas Sea
programme.desc: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Secret Ocean
programme.desc: Jean-Michel Cousteau, son of ocean pioneer Jacques Cousteau, offers a breakthrough look at a secret world within the ocean that is perhaps the biggest story of all—that the smallest life in the sea is the mightiest force on which we all depend. Alongside marine biologist Holly Lohuis, he invites viewers to dive into this whole new world that will leave them in awe of the beauty and diversity of the oceans – the source of all life on our planet – and inspire an even stronger desire to protect what they have either seen for the first time or perhaps re-discovered along the journey.

programme.title: Sperm Whales, Dealing with the Unexpected
programme.desc: Around the Crozet Islands, here is the incredible odyssey of a family of Sperm Whales facing rapid changes in their environment.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey
programme.desc: 500 million years ago life left this blue womb and colonized the land, but we are still intricately linked to the ocean. Our climates, coastlines, ecosystems, and economies are tied to the perpetual movement of water between continents. The great ocean currents are the arteries and veins of Planet Earth! This is the story of one particularly fascinating flow – the East Australian Current, a massive oceanic river that stretches the length of Australia's east coast.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Fragile Meditarranean
programme.desc: Many of the Mediterranean's coastal waters around harbour cities like Marseille were polluted mercilessly in the past, and much of the local reef life died. Now there is change in the air: pollution has been reduced and artificial reefs encourage wildlife to return. Frederic will carry out wildlife population surveys here and oceanographer Sandrine Ruiton hopes that his results will be exceptionally accurate, since noiseless freediving is much less invasive than conventional diving methods.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: The Great White Sharks of Guadalupe
programme.desc: The great white shark has a fearsome reputation and diving with them is definitely a risky business. But Frederic wants to show a different side of the infamous great white: Mexican zoologist Mauricio Hoyos believes that their aggression is triggered by excessive disturbance in the water. He wants to get to the bottom of the sharks' secretive migrations and their interactions with other species, including humans.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: 24 Hours on the Reef
programme.desc: The atoll of Fakarava in Polynesia is a true underwater paradise with an extraordinary diversity of wildlife. Frederic's freediving mission here is very ambitious: he wants to investigate the atoll's 24-hour rhythm of life, dive with its residents round the clock and record the reef's sounds. Documenting the atoll's life in this way could bring ground-breaking insights for scientist Prof. Serge Plane and allow him to explore the interrelationships between different reef organisms in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Ocean Oasis
programme.desc: Plunge into the wildly spectacular Sea of Cortes and join beautiful naturalist Iliana Ortega to swim with whales, dolphins, sharks, and giant manta rays.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Plastic floats. This is where our story begins. Millions of tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year, from rivers and shores, ships, and platforms. The world's scientists have studied the phenomenon and come to alarming conclusions.

programme.title: Ocean Origins
programme.desc: 4 billion years in the ocean, from the very beginning of life up to the incredible moment when the first vertebrate emerged onto dry land and opened a path to the conquest of the continents, Origins of Life examines the fascinating sea-creatures that are still alive today.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: Turtle Odyssey
programme.desc: Sea turtles are some of Earth's most ancient and majestic creatures. For over 100 million years, they have traversed the seas, enduring mass extinctions and playing critical roles in maintaining food webs. But now they face a new threat – humans. It's time we learned more about these remarkable reptiles.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.
